diagram_previews.alt: Rectangle ABCD with diagonal AC as the axis of rotation; triangle ACD reflected to AD'C above the axis, with the upper envelope A-D'-K-B-C highlighted in red.

difficulty_rationale: The key insight is that the two halves overlap after rotation, so one must take the upper envelope of the two triangles, then integrate (or add cones).
